derivation: middle voice from G1223 (διά) and G191 (ἀκούω);
def: to hear throughout, i.e. patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea)

occurrences.text: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod’s judgment hall.
